name: 제니
motion_summary: Eternal Return Jenny Queen of the Awards Ceremony: blonde film star wearing black-red fitted dress, white fur stole, red sunglasses on top of head; preserve elegant eyes and tiny confident smile. R creates an awards stage centered on her then releases a charming finale. Exact 12 poses: elegant ready; hand to chest; extend arm; raise wrist; compact golden circular stage ring appears around feet; confident red-carpet turn of shoulders; other arm sweep; hand raised high; golden spotlight rays burst outward with small pink heart charm accents, NOT face-covering; curtsey follow-through; stole settles; ready. Stage is a magical floor effect only, no actual scenery or curtains.
visual_review: 금발·머리 위 선글라스·드레스·숄과 손/몸 포즈 변화가 보입니다. 무대와 매혹이 얼굴을 가리지 않습니다.
